content: We use a neural CRF model as the baseline system BIBREF9 , treating NER as a sequence labeling problem over Chinese characters, which has achieved state-of-the-art performances BIBREF5 . To this end, we explore the BIEO schema to convert NER into sequence labeling, following BIBREF2 lample-EtAl:2016:N16-1, where sentential character is assigned with one unique tag. Concretely, we tag the non-entity character by label “O”, the beginning character of an entity by “B-XX”, the ending character of an entity by “E-XX” and the other character of an entity by “I-XX”, where “XX” denotes the entity type.
